title: 离线恢复实操：六个复制初始化状态的进程重新建立唯一标识、凭据与连接
body:
## 操作任务
实现after_restore(state,now,refresh,connect)。state为复制的初始化状态，含environment_id、已过期credential和旧connection；输入不得改动。返回新dict，environment_id用系统安全随机源恢复后新生成；credential通过refresh()恰调用一次取得并复制，expires必须大于now；connect()恰一次取得新socket，发PING\n并收到PONG\n后才返回到connection字段。新连接健康检查失败应关闭连接并抛错，凭据刷新失败或仍过期必须中止，不能沿用旧状态。验收实际fork六个非root进程共享相同初始内存，分别检查标识不同、模拟凭据新鲜及新TCP连接可反复使用。这里只实现恢复后业务逻辑，不注册AWS运行时hook；state中的旧连接不能复用。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
离线云模拟；使用真实Linux fork和私有TCP echo服务演示应用内存复制风险；不是Lambda内存快照、SnapStart恢复或AWS凭据服务实测。当前Python3.11教学运行时不冒称支持托管SnapStart。凭据仅toy字符串，未测试生产回滚、旧重复业务数据修复及随机性统计证明。 不调用云API、不部署、不构建镜像，不计真实云故障闭环。
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
rubric: 解释AWS具体机制及适用范围
列出能推翻错误假设的反例
明确配置恢复与数据副作用的差异

title: 离线分片交接实操：合并全部父分片终结，SQLite检查点重启后才开放子分片
body:
## 操作任务
实现ready_shards(shards,checkpoints)，返回可推进分片ID的排序列表，输入不变。规范化shards含唯一非空id、parents列表（0至2个不同父ID）、state=OPEN/CLOSED/EXPIRED；全部亲缘关系已提供。checkpoints映射ID到十进制sequence字符串或显式SHARD_END。序列数值再大也不等于EOF，CLOSED也不等于已消费完。只有全部父分片都持久化SHARD_END才开放子分片；未结束的独立OPEN/CLOSED根可推进，已SHARD_END和EXPIRED本身不推进。拒绝未知父/检查点、OPEN父仍被引用、循环、OPEN标终结、LATEST伪检查点、未读完已EXPIRED历史。已经终结的EXPIRED父允许子分片继续；缺失历史须ValueError而非跳过。真实SQLite保存检查点后重启解释器验收合并、拆分与大序列。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
离线云模拟；有限规范化Kinesis亲缘和检查点控制模型；SQLite仅教学持久化，不实现DynamoDB lease/KCL、Kinesis API、哈希范围路由、业务exactly-once或实际reshard。SHARD_END由可信消费层在EOF及副作用已确认后提供，本函数不从序列号推导；未知/过期亲缘拒绝并转外部补偿。 不调用云API、不部署、不构建镜像，不计真实云故障闭环。

import copy,json,os,pathlib,sqlite3,subprocess,sys,tempfile
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd())
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
print('OFFLINE_CLOUD_SCOPE:NO_CLOUD_API_REQUESTS',flush=True)
import task
shards=[{'id':'left','parents':[],'state':'CLOSED'},{'id':'right','parents':[],'state':'CLOSED'},
 {'id':'merged','parents':['left','right'],'state':'CLOSED'},
 {'id':'child-a','parents':['merged'],'state':'OPEN'},{'id':'child-b','parents':['merged'],'state':'OPEN'},
 {'id':'independent','parents':[],'state':'OPEN'}]
before=copy.deepcopy(shards)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='lineage-checkpoint-') as directory:
 path=pathlib.Path(directory)/'checkpoints.db'
 with sqlite3.connect(path) as db:db.execute('CREATE TABLE checkpoints(shard TEXT PRIMARY KEY,value TEXT NOT NULL)')
 def persist(values):
  with sqlite3.connect(path) as db:
   for key,value in values.items():db.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO checkpoints VALUES(?,?)',(key,value))
 def saved():
  with sqlite3.connect(path) as db:return dict(db.execute('SELECT shard,value FROM checkpoints'))
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:wait_for_all_parent_shard_end_checkpoints_across_merge_split_restart',flush=True)
 assert task.ready_shards(shards,{})==['independent','left','right']
 persist({'left':'SHARD_END','right':'42'})
 assert task.ready_shards(shards,saved())==['independent','right'],'merge started before all parents reached terminal checkpoint'
 persist({'right':'SHARD_END'})
 assert task.ready_shards(shards,saved())==['independent','merged']
 persist({'merged':'999999999999999999999999999999'})
 assert task.ready_shards(shards,saved())==['independent','merged'],'sequence checkpoint was incorrectly treated as terminal EOF'
 # Restart a real interpreter and reopen durable checkpoints; no in-memory lineage-progress shortcut.
 probe="import json,sqlite3,sys;sys.path.insert(0,'.');import task;d=sqlite3.connect(sys.argv[1]);print(json.dumps(task.ready_shards(json.loads(sys.argv[2]),dict(d.execute('SELECT shard,value FROM checkpoints')))))"
 assert json.loads(subprocess.check_output([sys.executable,'-c',probe,str(path),json.dumps(shards)],text=True))==['independent','merged']
 persist({'merged':'SHARD_END'})
 assert task.ready_shards(shards,saved())==['child-a','child-b','independent']
 checkpoint=saved();original_checkpoint=dict(checkpoint)
 assert task.ready_shards(list(reversed(shards)),checkpoint)==['child-a','child-b','independent']
 assert checkpoint==original_checkpoint and shards==before
 for changed,cp in [
  ([{'id':'lost','parents':[],'state':'EXPIRED'}],{}),
  ([{'id':'child','parents':['missing'],'state':'OPEN'}],{}),
  ([{'id':'a','parents':['b'],'state':'CLOSED'},{'id':'b','parents':['a'],'state':'CLOSED'}],{}),
  ([{'id':'live','parents':[],'state':'OPEN'}],{'live':'SHARD_END'}),
  (shards,{'missing':'1'}), (shards,{'left':'LATEST'})]:
  try:task.ready_shards(changed,cp)
  except ValueError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('unknown/expired history or invalid lineage was silently skipped')
 assert task.ready_shards([{'id':'old','parents':[],'state':'EXPIRED'}],{'old':'SHARD_END'})==[]
 print('OFFLINE_KINESIS_ALL_MERGE_PARENTS_END_BEFORE_CHILDREN_SEQUENCE_IS_NOT_EOF_SQLITE_RESTART_AND_EXPIRED_GAP_REFUSAL',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
